mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shopion.tPrfCustStore WHERE CustId = #{custId} AND StoreCode = #{storeCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopion.tPrfCustStore (CustId, StoreCode, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate, ChangeId, ChangeName, ChangeDate) VALUES (#{custId}, #{storeCode}, #{state}, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW(), #{changeId}, #{changeName}, NOW())

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shopion.tPrfCustStore WHERE CustId = #{custId} AND StoreCode = #{storeCode}
